sounds.name: navigation
sounds.description: Moving between panes. Almost subliminal: one soft, slightly falling blip.

sounds.name: selection
sounds.description: Picking an item. A single short tick a fifth above navigation, so the two read as a pair.

sounds.name: confirmation
sounds.description: Something you asked for worked. Two notes rising a fourth, warm and unhurried.

sounds.name: warning
sounds.description: Attention needed, nothing broken. A held pair a whole tone apart, gently pulsing — noticeable without alarm.

sounds.name: error
sounds.description: Something did not work. A low falling minor third with a soft body — sombre, never harsh, and never a buzzer.

sounds.name: achievement
sounds.description: You unlocked something. A four-note major-ninth arpeggio on struck bells with a sparkle above it.

sounds.name: sale
sounds.description: A sale landed. An original warm bell bloom: root, major sixth and octave struck together, with a slow swell underneath so it feels like good news arriving rather than a till ringing. Deliberately unlike any commercial notification tone.

sounds.name: workflow-complete
sounds.description: An automation finished. Three notes settling downward onto the tonic — the sound of a thing being put away.

sounds.name: connection-established
sounds.description: An integration or the Bridge came online. A fifth rising out of a short breath of air.

sounds.name: launcher-ready
sounds.description: Nexus has finished starting and the desktop is yours. A wide, slow chord that opens rather than announces.

sounds.name: update-available
sounds.description: A new version is ready to install. Two identical soft bells, an unhurried double-tap that asks nothing of you.
